title: Компромисс и билет на дерби  (Compromise and the Derby Ticket)

scenes.title: The Anniversary Gift
scenes.summary: Elena Pavlovna surprises Chef Barinov on their anniversary with a rare VIP ticket to the Spartak football derby.

scenes.title: The Bet for the Football Ticket
scenes.summary: Mikhail challenges Chef Barinov to a race drinking three beers against three shots of cognac for the VIP football ticket.

scenes.title: The Trap Under the Beer Glass
scenes.summary: Mikhail traps Chef Barinov's third shot glass under an upside-down beer mug so the Chef cannot reach it without breaking the rules.

scenes.title: Blue Paint and the Broken Shower
scenes.summary: Fedya pranks Denis with bank-security dye in the locker room, and Katya lends Max her hotel room key so he can take a shower.

scenes.title: Meeting by the Room and Asking Timur
scenes.summary: Eleonora catches Max at Katya's hotel room door and assumes they are dating, while Timur tells Chef Barinov no derby tickets are left.

scenes.title: The Second Ticket and Talk About Max
scenes.summary: Elena tells Chef Barinov she got a second ticket next to his seat, and Eleonora asks Chef about Max's chaotic personal life.

scenes.title: Chasing Someone Else's Ticket
scenes.summary: Seeing Mikhail give a football ticket to a hotel guest, Chef Barinov chases the guest outside and grabs the ticket from him.

scenes.title: The Ticket Was in the Pocket All Along
scenes.summary: Mikhail reveals he had already slipped Chef Barinov's ticket back into his pocket, and confiscates it to calm the angry hotel guest.

scenes.title: Twenty Thousand for a Breakup
scenes.summary: Eleonora offers Max twenty thousand dollars to break up with Katya and kicks him out before he can explain they are just colleagues.

scenes.title: The Lie About the Kitchen Rush
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov lies to Elena Pavlovna that he must miss the football match because the kitchen is short-staffed and swamped with orders.

scenes.title: An Expensive Clinic for Vika
scenes.summary: Kostya overhears Vika discussing an expensive maternity center and asks Max why he has not given Vika money for the birth.

scenes.title: An Emergency Day Off in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: When Elena arrives at the restaurant to help Chef Barinov, he frantically sends all the cooks away and hides Lyova so his lie holds up.

scenes.title: A Discounted Deal
scenes.summary: Max tells Eleonora he agrees to break up with Katya for ten thousand dollars instead of twenty, and she tells him to come to her suite tonight.

scenes.title: Rumors at the Bar Counter
scenes.summary: While a hostess applicant waits in the dining room, Denis tells Kostya he saw Max leaving Eleonora's suite and heard her invite him back tonight.

scenes.title: The Supposed Wife of the Oligarch
scenes.summary: When Elena asks where the VIP guest is, Chef Barinov points to the woman waiting in the hall and claims she is billionaire Friedman's wife.

scenes.title: Friedman's New Wife
scenes.summary: Eleonora says the woman is not Friedman's wife, so Chef Barinov claims she is Friedman's new wife, convincing Eleonora to roll out the red carpet.

scenes.title: The Quirks of Rich People
scenes.summary: Mikhail gives Oksana a VIP card, and when she asks to apply for the hostess vacancy, the managers think it is an eccentric rich woman's whim.

scenes.title: Ilya's Unsuccessful Interview
scenes.summary: Ilya tries to hit on Oksana during her hostess interview and gets slapped, while Mikhail chuckles at what he thinks are a rich woman's whims.

scenes.title: Exposure in Eleonora's Suite
scenes.summary: Katya bursts into her mother's suite thinking Max is sleeping with Eleonora for money, and learns Eleonora tried to pay Max to dump her.

scenes.title: A Kind Anniversary Tradition
scenes.summary: Katya realizes Eleonora also bribed Denis, while Chef Barinov and Elena celebrate their anniversary happily after cooking together.
